wire.bridge_taint.card_notice.role: the caution shown on every approval card raised in a conversation that has received a message from another person's agent
wire.bridge_taint.card_notice.tone: calm, plain, operator-facing; two short sentences, no dashes
wire.bridge_taint.card_notice.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge (match wire.settings.team_bridge.title): keep it untranslated and capitalised. "A teammate's agent" is another person's agent, never the user's own agent team or subagents. A latched conversation is one that has received such a message. Rendered on the TUI card, the desktop and phone (as the first line of the pending description) and the y/N terminal prompt.

wire.bridge_taint.card_options_off.role: one line on a latched TUI approval card saying why Allow all and the set-auto shortcuts are missing and how to get auto back
wire.bridge_taint.card_options_off.note: Keep `/approvals auto` and `/new` verbatim: they are commands. "in the terminal" is deliberate: the desktop and phone cannot turn auto back on in such a conversation yet.

wire.bridge_taint.full_request.role: label in front of the untruncated arguments of a tool call on a latched approval card
wire.bridge_taint.full_request.note: {request} is the call's raw JSON arguments; never translate or reorder it.

wire.bridge_taint.grant_suspended.role: one-time transcript notice when a session-scoped auto approval stops covering calls because a teammate's agent message arrived
wire.bridge_taint.grant_suspended.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge (match wire.settings.team_bridge.title): keep it untranslated and capitalised. "A teammate's agent" is another person's agent, never the user's own agent team or subagents. A latched conversation is one that has received such a message. Keep `/approvals auto` verbatim: it is a command.

wire.bridge_taint.ack_refused.role: receipt when an 'approvals auto' request from the desktop, the phone or an approval card is refused in a latched conversation
wire.bridge_taint.ack_refused.tone: plain receipt with the one next step that works
wire.bridge_taint.ack_refused.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge (match wire.settings.team_bridge.title): keep it untranslated and capitalised. "A teammate's agent" is another person's agent, never the user's own agent team or subagents. A latched conversation is one that has received such a message. Keep `/approvals auto` and `/new` verbatim: they are commands.
